w.t: Now it came to pass in the days
where she was, and her two
with you, as ye have dealt
unto her, Surely we will return
with me? are there yet any more
, that they may be your husbands?

f.t: should have…: or *were with an husband*

w.t: for your sakes that the hand

f.t: it grieveth…: Heb. *I have much bitterness*

w.t: and there will I be buried
And it came to pass, when they were come
I pray you, let me glean
thee? and when thou art athirst
unto him, Why have I found
me, all that thou hast done
be given thee of the Lord
me, and for that thou hast spoken
though I be not like unto one
And when she was risen up
and it was about an ephah
to her that she had reserved
unto her, Where hast thou gleaned
be he that did take knowledge
unto us, one of our next kinsmen

f.t: one of…: or, *one that hath right to redeem*

w.t: unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast
for thee, that it may be well
upon thee, and get thee down
And it shall be, when he lieth down

f.t: uncover: or, *lift up the clothes that are on*

w.t: unto her, All that thou sayest
according to all that her mother in law
And it came to pass at midnight

f.t: a near…: or, *one that hath right to redeem*

w.t: to thee all that thou requirest
and it shall be in the morning
if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman
let him do the kinsman’s part
not do the part of a kinsman
to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman
but if thou wilt not redeem

f.t: I thought…: Heb. *I said, I will reveal in thine ear*

w.t: for thee. So he drew off

f.t: do thou…: or, *get thee riches*, or, *power*
left…: Heb. *caused to cease unto thee*

w.t: And he shall be unto thee a restorer
